about: Virtues the «صاحب المنقبة» quiz does not ask, keyed by the virtue's id (unit#assertion), each with why. They stay on the person's page. A virtue goes here when another person in the app could rightly be its answer too: general praise («من كبراء الصحابة», «من أشراف قومه»), or one shared by a group. The batch threads add to it when they read the generated questions (conversion GUIDE.md, check 4).

skip.siyar-v4-74-usayd#a_us_v_naqib: One of the twelve naqibs; Sa'd ibn al-Rabi' and Abd Allah ibn Amr are naqibs in the app too.
skip.siyar-v4-63-saad-ibn-al-rabi#a_sr_v_naqi: One of the naqibs of al-Aqabah; Usayd and Abd Allah ibn Amr are naqibs in the app too.
